scope: Initial geographic and authored-export capability estimates. Not a digital twin of the simulation. Real-connections generation remains opt-in; the public writer still uses template corridors.

promise_levels.promised: The stated capability has relevant native evidence bound to this exact export and test conditions. Never inferred from stock-map ranks, metadata counts or geographic similarity.
promise_levels.likely: The deterministic model found a candidate. Game behavior or simulation stability remains unverified for this export.
promise_levels.not_possible_here: The current export plan lacks this capability under the stated rule. Not a claim that no other generator or human map-maker could provide it.
promise_levels.unknown: Inputs, a model or relevant game observations are missing. Absence of evidence is not a negative result.

ship.limits: Four-connected block-min depth grid with one-cell shore clearance; a component must reach the central 25 tiles and two separated edge points. Bounds are modelling choices, not measured game limits. The existing ship generator can smooth a path outside this corridor; an authored route still needs its own check.

stock_reference.excluded: CO.crp: blank editor terrain system package
stock_reference.quantiles: Linear interpolation at (n-1)*p; bands strictly below p25, inclusive typical, strictly above p75. Descriptive, not quality gates.

wet_central_fraction.name: Wet share of the central 25 tiles

terrain_relief_m.name: Terrain relief across the whole map

capabilities.name: Road
capabilities.definition: An authored directed highway/ramp route connects an incoming outside node to a different outside node. Reachable start-tile arrival/departure stubs are a separate requirement, not implied by this route.

promise_levels.promised: Exact-export directed native car paths pass, separately from a legal starting hookup.
promise_levels.not_possible_here: No such route in the current authored graph.
promise_levels.unknown: No authored graph; mapped roads alone are a preliminary candidate.

capabilities.limits: Counts do not prove direction, pathfinding or the player's ability to join. The real-roads path remains opt-in.

capabilities.name: Rail
capabilities.definition: An authored railway connects two distinct outside nodes through the square. This does not include stations or prove useful freight/passenger service.

promise_levels.promised: Exact-export native train path succeeds under the recorded test.
promise_levels.not_possible_here: Current export contains no such rail route.
promise_levels.unknown: Missing railway observations or graph; synthetic rail feasibility not solved.

capabilities.limits: Missing OSM rail is not geographic impossibility. Grade, tunnel portals, crossings and native lanes need independent verification.

capabilities.name: Ship
capabilities.definition: A ship-route candidate is supported by an authored edge-to-edge ship route or a broad deep corridor in the initial water plan. Route existence, broad-corridor support, native pathfinding and sustained navigability are separate observations.

promise_levels.promised: Exact-export native ship path is accepted, with water stability separately qualified for any sustained-service claim.
promise_levels.likely: An authored edge-to-edge ship route or a candidate initial deep-water corridor exists. A coarse corridor miss cannot veto an authored route; neither is native navigability proof.
promise_levels.not_possible_here: Both the authored route and the broad corridor are absent in the supplied final export plan, under the stated checks. This does not rule out another planner or a narrower route missed by coarsening.
promise_levels.unknown: The planner was explicitly disabled, neither kind of candidate was established and one input is missing, or only a browser estimate is available. Missing evidence is not a negative geographic result.

capabilities.limits: Not restricted by place names or ocean labels. Initial water is not stable water. A negative browser estimate is unknown because coarse sampling can miss a route.

capabilities.name: Air
capabilities.definition: An authored flight path joins two distinct outside nodes. The player's airport and its usable approach are separate capabilities.

promise_levels.promised: Exact-export native airplane path succeeds under the recorded test.
promise_levels.likely: Authored edge-to-edge flight path exists, or mapped runway supplies a preliminary approach candidate.
promise_levels.not_possible_here: Current export has no authored flight route.
promise_levels.unknown: No runway observation; a synthetic flight route may still be feasible.

capabilities.limits: Fixture airport fallbacks in the existing generator are not geographic evidence for arbitrary squares. Terrain clearance at high altitude and service remain unverified.

capabilities.name: Fresh water
capabilities.definition: A reachable clean fresh-water intake can supply the starting population, with enough sustained flow and a sewage outlet that does not contaminate it.

promise_levels.promised: Exact-package sustained native intake and sewage test passes with recorded demand.
promise_levels.likely: A future fitted flow/intake model finds a candidate.
promise_levels.not_possible_here: A complete model rules out the stated water-supply option, not all alternatives.
promise_levels.unknown: Wet pixels alone do not establish clean intake capacity.

capabilities.limits: PL-1078 owns this model/oracle. Groundwater availability is a separate fallback. Historical first-hour failures are not map-fault labels until the player policy passes stock controls.

capabilities.name: Start site
capabilities.definition: A dry legal build site in an unlockable starting tile can join a reachable outside road using geometry the game accepts.

promise_levels.promised: Exact-export native construction and road hookup pass.
promise_levels.likely: A future fitted site-and-hookup model finds a witness.
promise_levels.not_possible_here: Current start policy cannot place a legal connected site.
promise_levels.unknown: Dry terrain or nearby roads alone do not prove a legal start.

capabilities.limits: PL-1078 owns start selection/hookup. Do not use historical 1/8 first-hour rate as exporter accuracy.

capabilities.name: Buildable land
capabilities.definition: Dry initial terrain with local slope below 15 percent in the central 25 tiles, recorded separately from the game's New Game buildable-area percentage and legal building placement.

promise_levels.promised: Exact-export native placement passes for a specified footprint.
promise_levels.not_possible_here: No qualifying samples in a complete final grid.

capabilities.limits: The 15-percent geometric area is not directly comparable to the native metadata bar or a guarantee of a contiguous build site.

capabilities.name: Resources
capabilities.definition: Ore, oil and fertile land are encoded in the unlockable 25 tiles; report their abundance, patch size and accessibility separately from extraction gameplay.

promise_levels.promised: Native resource readback matches the exact export; extraction is a separate test.
promise_levels.likely: Final resource plan contains accessible cells.
promise_levels.not_possible_here: Specified resource absent from the final plan.
promise_levels.unknown: Land cover, deposits or final resource plan not evaluated.

capabilities.limits: Balanced mode adds synthetic ore/oil to stock-map shares. Distinguish measured deposits from generated gameplay resources.

capabilities.name: Trees
capabilities.definition: Biome-appropriate tree instances and forest resource cover are placed across the square, with room for starting growth rather than a uniform tree quota alone.

promise_levels.promised: Exact-export native tree/resource readback and visual check pass.
promise_levels.likely: Final tree plan contains instances and forest cover.
promise_levels.unknown: No tree plan or land-cover observation.

capabilities.limits: A count is not visual quality or biome correctness. Vanilla tree budget and central versus outer-ring coverage remain separate.

capabilities.name: Stable water
capabilities.definition: Water remains within the flood boundary and retains required mapped reaches during a full native simulation run.

promise_levels.promised: Exact-package full native simulation meets recorded flooding and retention limits.
promise_levels.likely: Not currently available from the existing risk screen.
promise_levels.not_possible_here: A relevant native failure or fitted deterministic impossibility, not merely a warning.
promise_levels.unknown: A clear screen is not a safety certificate.

calibration.limits: Retrospective fitting, not independent agreement. All 50 drying cases are positive; always-warn has the same score. Seven other complete runs are unscored. PL-1072 independent geography is still incomplete; no cleared-square safety claim.

capabilities.limits: Preserve the existing water-risk download gate. This ledger does not lower its thresholds or waive warnings.

required: Native-accepted outside road access and a legal connected start
Pre-baked hydrology with qualified clean intake and sustained water
Honest per-square transport options, with explicit optional rail/ship/air absence
Measured buildable room and accessible gameplay resources
descriptive_not_gates: Central forest cover and total tree count
launch_bar_proposal.limits: Proposal, not launch approval. A higher interest metric is not always better. No hand-picked map fixes.
